Subject:          Request for U.S. NRC to Rescind Approved Exemption Related to the Suspension
                  of Security Measures in an Emergency or During Severe Weather

In Reference 1, Constellation Energy Generation (CEG) stated that CEG would request rescission
of NRC-approved decommissioning-related exemptions as part of the Christopher M. Crane Clean
Energy Center (CCEC) transition out of decommissioning. This letter provides CEG’s request for
NRC to rescind the exemption related to required approvals of the suspension of security
measures in an emergency or during severe weather for Three Mile Island Nuclear Station1
(TMINS) by either a licensed senior operator or a Certified Fuel Handler (CFH) before taking action
(Reference 2). This exemption was approved in Reference 3.

CEG requests NRC to rescind this exemption no later than docketing withdrawal of the
10 CFR 50.82(a)(1) certifications per the exemption requested in Reference 4. Rescission of the
exemption would restore the approval authority to suspend security measures in an emergency or
during severe weather for TMINS to a licensed senior operator, in accordance with
10 CFR 73.55(p)(1)(i) and 10 CFR 73.55(p)(1)(ii).

There are no new or revised regulatory commitments contained in this submittal.

For questions regarding this submittal, please contact Hannah Pell, Regulatory Specialist, CCEC,
at hannah.pell@constellation.com.

Respectfully,
Moore, Digitally  signed by
